title: IDOC Admissions Data
subtitle: Dataset
abstract: This is a datasets of all entries into the Illinois Department of Corrections (IDOC) prison system from 2011 to 2025.

title: Prison Exit Data
subtitle: Dataset
abstract: This is a datasets of all exits from the Illinois Department of Corrections (IDOC) prison system from 2011 to 2025.

title: Prison Population Data
subtitle: Dataset
abstract: This datasets is an elongated .csv of appended prison daily population files. Daily populations are a single daily snapshots of the prision's population on a given day. The IDOC releases these files quarterly. This dataset contains all the prison populations from 2011 - 2025.
